title: Tor amplitude in a fixed interval is local on open neighbourhoods
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] with chosen derived localizations for module sheaves on $X$ and on each open subscheme [def-pc-derived-category]. Let $E\in D(\mathcal O_X)$ and $a\leq b$ be integers. Suppose every point $x\in X$ has an open neighbourhood $U$ such that for every $\mathcal O_U$-module $G$ and every $i\notin[a,b]$, $H^i(L(U\hookrightarrow X)^*E\otimes^L G)=0$ [def-pc-derived-pullback, def-pc-derived-tensor-cohomology-vanishes]. Then for every $\mathcal O_X$-module $G$ and every $i\notin[a,b]$, $H^i(E\otimes^L G)=0$. The interval is fixed before choosing the neighbourhood or test module; no compactness or quasi-coherence is assumed.

source.place: Tag 08CG (definition-tor-amplitude); Tag 09U9 (lemma-tor-amplitude-stalk), proof and finite-subcover consequence

proof.text: Fix G and i outside the interval. Choose a K-flat representative P of E using [lem-pc-kflat-resolution] and essential surjectivity of Q. By [lem-pc-kflat-derived-tensor-comparison] its total tensor with G in degree zero computes the derived tensor, independently of any other K-flat representative.

At each x choose U from the hypothesis. Open tensor pullback agrees with exact restriction: both are left adjoint to the same pushforward, hence uniquely isomorphic; deriving exact restriction computes its termwise functor (the construction [def-pc-derived-pullback]). Restriction preserves K-flatness and total tensor by [lem-pc-open-restriction-kflat-model] and [lem-pc-open-restriction-total-tensor]; equivalently use [lem-pc-derived-tensor-open-restriction-universes]. Apply the local bound to the restriction of G. The K-flat comparison identifies its zero cohomology with the restriction of the cohomology of the fixed global tensor model.

The global cohomology sheaf therefore has zero stalk at every x. Apply [pqf-lem-sheaf-zero-stalks]. Together with P and its representation isomorphism this witnesses [def-pc-derived-tensor-cohomology-vanishes]. The same argument applies when X is empty.

theorem torAmplitude_of_open_neighbourhoods (X : Scheme.{u})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ U : X.Opens,
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    (E : schemeDerivedCategory X) (a b : ℤ) (hab : a ≤ b)
    (h : ∀ x : X, ∃ U : X.Opens, x ∈ U ∧
      ∀ (G : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace)) (i : ℤ),
        i < a ∨ b < i → schemeDerivedTensorCohomologyVanishes U.toScheme
          ((derivedPullback U.ι).obj E) G i) :
    ∀ (G : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) (i : ℤ),
      i < a ∨ b < i → schemeDerivedTensorCohomologyVanishes X E G i
